headline: Kernex Microsystems Q2FY27 net profit surges to ₹12,900.83 lakh
summary: Kernex Microsystems posted consolidated net profit of ₹12,900.83 lakh for Q2FY27, up sharply from ₹652.09 lakh in Q2FY26. Revenue from operations rose to ₹54,263.17 lakh. The board also granted 25,000 ESOPs to eligible employees.

headline: Gufic Biosciences Q2FY27: PAT up 58% YoY to ₹23.5 crore
summary: Gufic Biosciences posted Q2FY27 net profit of ₹23.5 crore, up 57.7% YoY, on total revenue of ₹288.4 crore. EBITDA margin expanded to 17.23% from 16.45% a year ago.

headline: Allcargo Global Q2FY27 results: profit turns positive
summary: Allcargo Global posted a standalone net profit of ₹6 crore in Q2FY27, reversing a ₹6 crore loss a year ago. Consolidated income from operations rose to ₹4,320 crore from ₹3,393 crore YoY.

headline: Swarnsarita Jewels Q2FY27 standalone net profit falls 93% QoQ
summary: Swarnsarita Jewels India Limited reported standalone net profit of ₹41.86 lakh for Q2FY27, down sharply from ₹1,110.56 lakh in Q1FY27, while revenue from operations rose to ₹23,988.68 lakh.

headline: Shikhar Consultants Q2FY27 net loss narrows, revenue nil
summary: Shikhar Consultants Limited posted a net loss of ₹209,437 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, versus ₹287,960 a year earlier. Revenue from operations was nil, and the Board approved the results on November 14, 2026.

headline: Mount Housing Q2FY27 results: net profit at ₹15.18 lakh
summary: Mount Housing & Infrastructure posted a net profit of ₹15.18 lakh for Q2FY27, reversing an operating loss, aided by a ₹59.40 lakh exceptional item. Revenue fell to ₹175.31 lakh.

headline: Ganesha Ecoverse H1FY27 Results: Turns profitable
summary: Ganesha Ecoverse posted a standalone net profit of ₹318.06 lakh for H1FY27, reversing a loss of ₹129.83 lakh in H1FY26, driven by a sharp rise in other income.

headline: Nexus Surgical Q2FY27 net profit at ₹17.01 lakh
summary: Nexus Surgical and Medicare posted net profit of ₹17.01 lakh for Q2FY27, with total income rising to ₹372.56 lakh. Revenue from sales and services grew sharply YoY to ₹370.87 lakh.

headline: Accord Transformer H1FY27 net profit up 238% YoY
summary: Accord Transformer & Switchgear posted net profit of ₹422.62 lakh for H1FY27, up sharply from ₹125.09 lakh a year ago, as revenue from operations rose to ₹5,268.22 lakh.

headline: Omkar Pharmachem Q2FY27 results: net profit at ₹0.39 lakh
summary: Omkar Pharmachem posted a net profit of ₹0.39 lakh for Q2FY27, down from ₹5.07 lakh in Q2FY26. Total income fell to ₹9.00 lakh from ₹13.94 lakh YoY.

headline: Nivaka Fashions Q2FY27 results: net loss narrows QoQ
summary: Nivaka Fashions reported a net loss of ₹12.40 lakh for Q2FY27, narrowing from ₹15.05 lakh in Q1FY27. The board also approved voluntary delisting from MSEI and CSE.

headline: Shipwaves Online H1FY27: standalone net loss widens
summary: Shipwaves Online's board approved H1FY27 unaudited results on November 14, 2026. Standalone net loss widened to ₹436.78 lakh while consolidated net profit stood at ₹515.29 lakh.

headline: Sankhya Infotech Q2FY27 loss widens to ₹95.22 lakh
summary: Sankhya Infotech reported a net loss of ₹95.22 lakh for Q2FY27, wider than ₹88.12 lakh in Q2FY26, with zero revenue from operations and total expenses of ₹117.98 lakh.

headline: SMC Credits board approves Q2FY27 unaudited results
summary: SMC Credits Limited board met on November 14, 2026 to approve unaudited financial results for Q2FY27 and H1FY27, along with a funds utilisation statement showing no deviation from its rights issue proceeds.

headline: Duro Pack CEO and CFO certify Q2FY27 half-year results
summary: Duro Pack Limited's CEO and CFO certified, to the best of their knowledge and belief, that Q2FY27 and half-year results ended September 30, 2026 contain no materially untrue statements. The statements present a true and fair view.

headline: SRU Steels Q2FY27: Zero revenue, net loss widens
summary: SRU Steels reported zero revenue from operations in Q2FY27, with net loss after tax widening to ₹14.47 lakh versus ₹18.63 lakh loss in Q2FY26. Board approved results on November 14, 2026.

headline: Shah Investor's Home Q2FY27 profit falls to ₹420.87 lakh
summary: Shah Investor's Home reported standalone net profit of ₹420.87 lakh for Q2FY27, down from ₹458.29 lakh a year earlier. Consolidated profit after tax was ₹358.53 lakh, with the board approving the results on November 14, 2026.

headline: Constronics Infra Q2FY27 standalone net profit at ₹104.72 lakh
summary: Constronics Infra posted standalone net profit of ₹104.72 lakh for Q2FY27, down from ₹142.29 lakh in Q2FY26. Consolidated net profit stood at ₹86.26 lakh for the same quarter.

headline: Dhampur Sugar Mills Q2FY27 results: profit turns positive
summary: Dhampur Sugar Mills reported a consolidated net profit of ₹12.62 crore for Q2FY27, reversing a loss of ₹7.82 crore in Q2FY26. Revenue from operations rose to ₹694.44 crore.

headline: AHB Capital Q2FY27 results: net loss widens YoY
summary: AHB Capital (formerly P H Capital) reported a net loss of ₹220.70 lakh for Q2FY27, wider than the ₹89.94 lakh loss in Q2FY26. The board also appointed Suyog Dhavan as Additional Director.

headline: KD Green board approves Skyline Financial as share registrar
summary: KD Green Industries Limited's board approved Skyline Financial Services as share registrar and transfer agent, replacing Beetal Financial & Computer Services. The decision was taken on November 14, 2026, and disclosed to BSE Limited.

headline: BIL Vyapar Q2 results noted by Committee of Creditors
summary: BIL Vyapar Limited's Committee of Creditors noted unaudited results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, at its November 14, 2026 meeting. The company is under CIRP, and the results are annexed to the filing.
